messages:
Alex: CI red on integrations after merged PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5123 — shard 7 failing several hosted API tests (tooling + auth + streaming). Can someone help bisect or rerun? cc @Maria @Sam
CI-Bot: nightly/integration · shard=7 · status=FAIL · failed=3 tests · tests: test_toolcall_schema_validation, test_stream_auth_reconnect, test_embed_auth_headers · logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/2113334444 · rerun: /ci rerun --shard=7
Maria: I can take the reruns now. starting with the failing shard rerun and a clean env.
Sam: sending quick ask — can you grab the failing test names + last failing commit SHA? I want to try a local repro.
Alex: last failing commit after merge: 9a4f3b2 (the PR merged at 10:12). Attaching a short log snippet that looks suspicious around auth handshake:
```
ERROR HostedClient - auth: 401 Unauthorized for session=shard7-req42
WARN  RetryPolicy - stream reconnect attempted (attempt=1)
ERROR ToolCallHandler - schema validation failed: missing "tool.args[0].type"
```
Jordan: fwiw, I saw a similar 401 yesterday in smoke runs but it recovered on rerun. Could be token rotation or a transient proxy.
Lee: if it's token TTL/rotate, the Hosted API proxy started honoring token-expires header in 9a4f3b2 — maybe the client lib didn't refresh correctly.
Tara: @Maria when you rerun can you include the --record-http option? want to see the auth handshake and kid header.
Maria: rerun kicked off: /ci rerun --shard=7 --record-http=true · build=2113334460. Will post logs when done.
CI-Bot: rerun started · build=2113334460 · queued on runner-gpu-12
Sam: trying a quick local repro with the same commit. command I'm running:
```
make dev-api && export REDWOOD_HOST=staging-hosted && pytest tests/integration/test_tooling.py::test_toolcall_schema_validation -k shard7 -q
```
Sam: got same schema error locally once — dumping the request payload shows a missing type field when the tool runtime is proxied through the streaming layer.
Alex: that aligns — PR 5123 touched streaming proxy headers and toolcall marshaling. Could be a regression in the adapter that strips fields when stream framing is present.
Jordan: can we bisect within the PR? Maybe try reverting just the streaming adapter change and run the three tests. If that passes, we'll have a narrower culprit.
Maria: build finished: 2113334460 — still failing same 3 tests. Uploading http recordings: https://ci.internal/redwood/2113334460/http-recordings.tar.gz
Lee: downloading recordings. early glance: client sends Authorization: Bearer <short-lived> then proxy returns 401 with x-retry-after. Looks like refresh didn't happen before request is forwarded.
Tara: quick patch idea — make the client check token validity before sending and force refresh if ttl < 5s. Can someone try a hotfix branch?
Sam: I'll open a quick PR with the TTL guard and run the tests locally. If it fixes the schema failure too, it implies client sent truncated payload due to reconnect.
Alex: thanks. If Sam's patch helps, we can ship a targeted revert for that adapter change and follow up with full fix. Else we'll bisect deeper.
Maria: one more datapoint — the failing runs are concentrated on runners that hit proxy v2 (eu/gce-runners). runners on aws-us are mostly green. Could be a regional config + cert rotation.
Jordan: good catch. tagging infra-config folks to check proxy rollout state. @Lee can you file a quick infra ticket with the proxy versions and cert rotate times?
Lee: filing ticket now: INFRA-3587 — linking CI builds and recordings.
Sam: opened PR 5130 with TTL guard + unit test. kicking off CI locally. will post results.
CI-Bot: PR 5130 · ci/presubmit · status=running · tests=integration(shard7)
Alex: appreciate the quick triage team. If anyone finds a fast revert candidate, ping me — we can cut a hotfix branch to restore green while we root-cause.
Maria: quick note — if you need me to queue a full matrix rerun (all regions), say so. for now I'll watch shard 7 and eu runners.
Sam: CI for PR 5130 passed shard7 locally and test_toolcall_schema_validation green. pushing to main branch for broader CI.
CI-Bot: PR 5130 · merged by Sam · merge-commit=9b7e2c1 · postmerge CI running full matrix.
Alex: leaving this thread open until full matrix is green. Thanks everyone, amazing quick work. :tada:
